New York factory orders nearly stalled. So why are factories hiring?
The New York Fed's Empire State factory index fell to 7.8 in November from 25.5 in October, far below forecasts of about 17 (released Nov 16).
New orders dropped to 3.0 from 23.2, but the hiring index rose to 18.1, its highest since June 2022. Only 3.4% of firms reported cutting staff, down from 9.8% in October.
The same survey: the six-month outlook rose to 28.9 and capital spending plans hit their highest since December 2022.
Sources: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Empire State Manufacturing Survey, Nov 16, 2026; Kitco; Seeking Alpha.
